nixSrcRecordedIn: flake.nix gmpPin.nixSrcHash (nixpkgs' archive of the same release)
why: Lean admits GMP into the kernel TCB and requires GMP >= 6.3.0 (older GMP can make it unsound); Wiz's Nat is a 62-bit scalar plus GMP on the host, so the bignum is part of the proof checker's trusted base. The release bundles the .tar.xz, nixpkgs builds the .tar.bz2; both are GMP 6.3.0 and each build path pins its own archive hash.
checkedBy: flake.nix: gmpPin and the assert in `unwrapped` (nix eval fails with the actual and pinned nix hashes named)
Tests/Groups/Numerics.lean: the `numerics` group reads flake.nix, scripts/bundle-cc.sources and this file and fails with all three values on a disagreement
release.yml: the bundled GMP is built from the hash in scripts/bundle-cc.sources and recorded in the SBOM (wiz:resolved-gmp)
